A national EdTech platform (2M learners) — Education & Research engagement delivered by a 13-person team over 11 months, Global scope, commercial model: build-run.

items: Engagement metrics ≠ learning proof; institutional renewals wobbled.
SOC 2 evidence assembled manually per audit.

blocks.x: Learning-gain pipelines (assessment → causal evidence with confounder care) now publish outcome reports per cohort; the content factory produces curriculum variants with editorial QC; and compliance automation turned SOC 2 audits into evidence sampling — procurement gates unblocked.
Structure followed the transfer principle — named pod, documented runbooks, enabled operators, and a Compound phase that kept challenger programs plus conformance monitoring running post-handover.

items: The part that survives audit is the boring part: the decision path and the audit path share one timeline across Education & Research, so drift shows up as a ticket with an owner, not as a mystery.
Bounded scope per gate, policy-checked writes on every path, and telemetry wired straight to your channels

blocks.x: Client identity withheld under confidentiality. Metrics are reported against the baseline locked in the Diagnose phase; the measurement method is available to seriously interested parties under NDA.
The engineering bet is explicit: signals cross boundaries only through typed contracts across Education & Research, and every exception path degrades to human review, never to silence.
